Compare the resources of two manifests

Source: R/capsule_cli.R
mnfdiff.Rd

Lists the resources (data files) of two manifests side by side and says which were added, removed or changed: a different SHA-256, or a different size where both sizes are recorded. A manifest is a provenance record (its resource), a capsule bundle (its files), a data frame with the columns path and sha256 (and optionally size_bytes), or the path of a JSON file holding one of the first two. cpsrfrsh and rmbl drift report what a fetched source changed with it.

Usage

mnfdiff(old, new)

# S3 method for class 'rmbl_mnfdiff'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'rmbl_mnfdiff'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

old, new

The two manifests, as described above. A list with neither resource nor files has no resources.

x

An rmbl_mnfdiff result.

...

Not used.

Value

A data frame of class rmbl_mnfdiff, one row per resource in either manifest, with the columns resource (the file name), change ("added", "removed", "changed" or "unchanged"), old_sha256, new_sha256, old_size and new_size (NA where not recorded). It prints the counts and one line per change. Errors: a manifest that is not a list, a data frame or a file; a data frame without path and sha256.

See also

cpsrfrsh, cpsbndl.

Examples

a <- data.frame(path = c("a.csv", "b.csv"), sha256 = c("01", "02"),
                size_bytes = c(10, 20))
b <- data.frame(path = c("a.csv", "c.csv"), sha256 = c("09", "03"),
                size_bytes = c(12, 30))
d <- mnfdiff(a, b)
d
#> Manifest diff: 1 changed, 1 added, 1 removed, 0 unchanged
#>   changed   a.csv  sha256 01 -> 09, 10 -> 12 bytes
#>   removed   b.csv  sha256 02 -> -, 20 -> - bytes
#>   added     c.csv  sha256 - -> 03, - -> 30 bytes
d$change
#> [1] "changed" "removed" "added"  

# a provenance record and its re-pinned copy
p <- list(resource = list(filename = "a.csv", sha256 = "01", size_bytes = 10))
q <- p
q$resource$sha256 <- "09"
mnfdiff(p, q)$change
#> [1] "changed"

try(mnfdiff(1, b))
#> Error : mnfdiff: `old` must be a provenance record, a capsule bundle, a data frame of path and sha256, or the path of a JSON file
